cost_and_affordability.rationale: The original campaign finished within its declared wall cap on the shared CPU host. Interrupted evaluation costs and discarded training work remain charged. Separate post-campaign replay costs are excluded from that cap. This is no matched performance or general affordability comparison.

pipeline.rationale: The bounded historical pipeline executed and its saved targets and checkpoints passed the scoped audits. Policy transfer showed a small descriptive probe change, critic calibration worsened, and both strength contrasts remained inconclusive. This run does not justify adopting the full recipe as an improvement or reject its execution machinery.
pipeline.scope: Adoption of the complete staged recipe for further learning.

strength.basis: Both prespecified simultaneous paired intervals include zero.

evaluation_accounting.preservation: Completed 72-game pilot evidence is outside this campaign. Completed 576-game reference evidence and interrupted original costs remain unchanged. Fixed balanced 288-game subsets retain original assignment identities and seeds.

final_evaluation.conclusion: Both prespecified paired contrasts are inconclusive. The point estimates do not establish playing-strength improvement.

stage1_policy_transfer.disjointness_evidence: The independent tensor audit checked all three fixed 512-label batches against the frozen probe digest set. This establishes exact-frame exclusion, not independence of all related game situations.
stage1_policy_transfer.interpretation: Heldout cross-entropy and forward KL decreased slightly. Top-one agreement did not change. These descriptive probe metrics do not establish a playing-strength gain.

stage3_critic_calibration.independent_actor_evidence: All eight calibration checkpoints changed only four critic tensors within state_dict. Actor logits were identical on all 512 heldout frames. Nonpersistent student buffers and historical process memory remain outside this audit.
stage3_critic_calibration.interpretation: The fixed eight-epoch calibration worsened heldout MSE and finished worse than the constant training-mean predictor. This is a negative calibration result. Heldout metrics did not select epochs.

stage4_ppo.diagnostic_scope: Exact saved diagnostics for all nine completed updates and their four epochs each. Gradient norms are measured before clipping. Losses and entropy are training-batch diagnostics, not independent generalization measures. The discarded partial tenth update is excluded from completed diagnostics and retained in total cost.

limitations: The shared-host campaign proves bounded execution, not a performance comparison.
Original PPO advantage and return input tensors were not serialized. Their production computation was replayed and independently crosschecked, not recovered from optimizer memory.
These audits do not independently observe historical live-process immutability or establish current-Standard actor privacy.
No new training, revised teacher buffers, dense-model arm or longer protocol is authorized by this readout.

The 76-check tensor audit compares state_dict and does not include nonpersistent buffers. The separate teacher replay checks all named teacher buffers, without observing historical student-buffer memory.

model_contract.teacher_encoding_note: The unchanged frozen reader retains its original encoding. Separate C12 qualification observes rule.lillie for card 1227 as 0 in this artifact versus 1 under C12 facts. This is a declared representation difference, not a reason to silently change teacher buffers or a blanket teacher-usability rejection. C12 reader source equivalence remains false.
